captured_with: WebFetch against each tool's own documentation
description: Per-ecosystem 'update everything to latest' commands, each verified against the upstream documentation linked in `source`. These are the commands reproduced by buildEcosystemsSection() in src/fix.update-dependencies.lib.mjs.

ecosystems.verified: README: `ncu -u` — 'Overwrite package file with upgraded versions instead of just outputting to console'; `--target latest` is the default and 'upgrades to whatever the package's latest dist-tag points to'. `npm update` alone stays inside the existing semver ranges and therefore never crosses a major.
uv guide: 'To upgrade all packages: $ uv lock --upgrade'.

ecosystems.command: cargo upgrade --incompatible && cargo update  (cargo-edit); cargo +nightly update --breaking -Z unstable-options
ecosystems.verified: Cargo docs: plain `cargo update` 'only updates Cargo.lock to the latest versions allowed by the version requirements already specified in Cargo.toml' and does not modify Cargo.toml. `cargo update --breaking` does modify the requirements but 'is unstable and available only on the nightly channel and requires -Z unstable-options'. Crossing a major therefore needs cargo-edit's `cargo upgrade --incompatible` on stable.
`go get -u` updates modules providing the named packages to newer minor or patch releases; `go mod tidy` then prunes go.mod/go.sum.

ecosystems.command: dotnet outdated -u  (dotnet-outdated global tool); dotnet list package --outdated
ecosystems.verified: README: `dotnet outdated -u` / `--upgrade` automatically upgrades all outdated packages; `-u:prompt` prompts per package.

versions-maven-plugin goals: `versions:display-dependency-updates` reports newer versions; `versions:use-latest-releases` 'searches for release versions and replaces them with the latest release version'. For Gradle, ben-manes' plugin id `io.github.ben-manes.versions` adds the `dependencyUpdates` task (https://github.com/ben-manes/gradle-versions-plugin).
`composer update` resolves inside composer.json constraints; crossing a major needs `composer require vendor/pkg:^X` to rewrite the constraint first.
`--all` updates every gem in the Gemfile to the newest version allowed by the Gemfile constraints.
Updates all dependencies in mix.lock inside the mix.exs constraints.

Docs: --major-versions 'gets the packages that dart pub outdated lists as resolvable, ignoring any upper-bound constraint in the pubspec.yaml file. Also updates pubspec.yaml with the new constraints.' Plain `dart pub upgrade` stays inside the constraints.
Updates Package.resolved within the Package.swift requirements; a major needs the requirement in Package.swift edited first.

ecosystems.command: Pin each `uses:` to the newest release (Dependabot `package-ecosystem: github-actions` automates it)
ecosystems.verified: `github-actions` is an accepted package-ecosystem value; it reads .github/workflows/*.yml and composite action.yml files.
